The argument in SRC_005 (that preference smuggles induction) is dependent on the interpretation of 'preference' as inherently tied to 'expectations of future performance' found in SRC_001. Refuted If: A coherent framework exists where 'preference' is defined strictly as a selection rule based on past falsification attempts, completely decoupled from any probabilistic weighting of future outcomes.
